Class Sorter

java.lang.Object
org.troy.capstone.search_engine.sorting.Sorter
public class Sorter extends Object
The Sorter class provides a method to sort a Table based on a given RowComparator. It uses Insertion Sort for small tables (25 rows or fewer) and QuickSort for larger tables. The sorting is performed on a copy of the original table, ensuring that the original data remains unchanged.

  • Field Details

    • SORTING_THRESHOLD

      private static final int SORTING_THRESHOLD
      Threshold for determining when to use Insertion Sort vs Quick Sort. If the number of rows is less than or equal to this threshold, Insertion Sort will be used; otherwise, Quick Sort will be used.

  • Method Details

    • sortTable

      static Table sortTable(Table table, RowComparator comparator, LongWrapper time)
      Sorts the given table using the specified RowComparator. If the table has 25 rows or fewer, it uses Insertion Sort; otherwise, it uses Quick Sort.
      Parameters:
      table - The Table to be sorted.
      comparator - The RowComparator that defines the sorting order. This is an Object to make it possible to pass a comparator from another class without the import of the RowComparator class.
      time - An optional LongWrapper to store the time taken to perform the sort. If null, time will not be recorded.
      Returns:
      A new Table instance containing the sorted rows from the input table.
      Preconditions:
      table is not null and contains the necessary columns for the comparator to function properly.
      Postconditions:
      The returned table is a new Table instance that contains the same rows as the input table but sorted according to the order defined by the comparator. The original table remains unchanged.

    • mixedSort

      @Deprecated public static void mixedSort(List<Row> rows, RowComparator comparator, LongWrapper time)
      Deprecated.
      This is useful for tests and analyzing time taken, but is not part of main program execution.
      Helper method to perform a mixed sort using Insertion Sort for small lists and Quick Sort for larger lists, with time measurement.
      Parameters:
      rows - The list of rows to be sorted.
      comparator - The RowComparator used to determine the order of the rows.
      time - An optional LongWrapper to store the time taken to perform the sort. If null, time will not be recorded.
      Preconditions:
      comparator is a valid RowComparator that can compare the rows in the list. rows is not null and the rows contain the correct column needed to do the sorting.
      Postconditions:
      The list of rows is sorted in place based on the order defined by the comparator, and the time taken for sorting is recorded in the provided LongWrapper if it is not null.

    • mixedSort

      @Deprecated private static void mixedSort(List<Row> rows, int low, int high, RowComparator comparator, LongWrapper time)
      Deprecated.
      This is useful for tests and analyzing time taken, but is not part of main program execution.
      Sorts the rows based on the provided comparator and optionally records the time taken for sorting. Uses Insertion Sort for small lists and Quick Sort for larger lists.
      Parameters:
      rows - The list of rows to be sorted.
      low - The starting index of the portion of the list to be sorted.
      high - The ending index of the portion of the list to be sorted.
      comparator - The RowComparator used to determine the order of the rows.
      time - An optional LongWrapper to store the time taken to perform the sort. If null, time will not be recorded.
      Preconditions:
      comparator is a valid RowComparator that can compare the rows in the list. rows is not null and the rows contain the correct column needed to do the sorting.
      Postconditions:
      The list of rows is sorted in place based on the order defined by the comparator, and the time taken for sorting is recorded in the provided LongWrapper if it is not null.
